# quickwit_source_pulsar (Resource)

An Apache Pulsar source.

Quickwit checks that it can reach the source when it is created or updated. Sources are deleted together with their index: when the index is replaced, add `lifecycle { replace_triggered_by = [quickwit_index.<name>] }` so the source is recreated in the same apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "quickwit_source_pulsar" "this" {
  index_id  = quickwit_index.logs.index_id
  source_id = "pulsar-source"
  topics    = ["persistent://public/default/logs"]
  address   = "pulsar+ssl://pulsar.example.com:6651"

  authentication = {
    token = var.pulsar_token
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) Broker URL, `pulsar://host:port` or `pulsar+ssl://host:port`.
- `index_id` (String) Index the source feeds. Changing it recreates the source.
- `source_id` (String) Source identifier, unique within the index. Changing it recreates the source.
- `topics` (List of String) Topics to consume.

### Optional

- `authentication` (Attributes, Sensitive) Authentication: set exactly one of `token` or `oauth2`. Sensitive. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication))
- `consumer_name` (String) Consumer name. Defaults to `quickwit`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the source is indexed. Defaults to `true`.
- `input_format` (String) Format of the messages: `json`, `plain_text`, `otlp_logs_json`, `otlp_logs_protobuf`, `otlp_traces_json`, `otlp_traces_protobuf`. Defaults to `json`.
- `num_pipelines` (Number) Number of indexing pipelines. Quickwit only supports `1` for this source type.
- `transform` (Attributes) [VRL](https://vector.dev/docs/reference/vrl/) transform applied to each document before indexing. Not supported with OTLP input formats. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--transform))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<index_id>:<source_id>`.

<a id="nestedatt--authentication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication`

Optional:

- `oauth2` (Attributes) OAuth2 client credentials flow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--oauth2))
- `token` (String, Sensitive) JWT token.

<a id="nestedatt--authentication--oauth2"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.oauth2`

Required:

- `credentials_url` (String) URL of the credentials file (`file:///path/creds.json` or `data:…`).
- `issuer_url` (String) Issuer URL.

Optional:

- `audience` (String) Audience.
- `scope` (String) Scope.



<a id="nestedatt--transform"></a>
### Nested Schema for `transform`

Required:

- `script` (String) VRL program, e.g. `.message = downcase(string!(.message))`.

Optional:

- `timezone` (String) TZ database timezone used by VRL time functions. Defaults to `UTC`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with <index_id>:<source_id>.
terraform import quickwit_source_pulsar.this logs:pulsar-source
```
